visual_summary: In a cluttered sci-fi laboratory or medical chamber, an elderly bearded man and a small robot attend to a woman lying in a suspended sleep apparatus. The man celebrates creating a perfect copy of Don Nicanor Rosamel de Rokha, then warns the robot that clones can still diverge from their originals. The woman is awakened from a weeks-long coma, recoils in pain and despair, begs to be put back to sleep forever, and accuses the others of cruelty. The robot argues that its master has recreated her father from a single cell by rebuilding both flesh and the neural programming of his mind.
